Complete painting services

Interior painting

Refresh a room or transform your entire interior with smooth, consistent color. We paint walls, ceilings, trim and other interior surfaces with careful preparation and respect for your home or workplace.

  • Walls, ceilings and trim
  • Single rooms and whole interiors
  • Residential and commercial spaces
02

Exterior painting

Improve curb appeal while helping protect exterior surfaces from Indiana weather. Our process focuses on preparation, clean application and a durable finished appearance.

  • Homes and commercial buildings
  • Siding, trim, fascia and soffits
  • Weather-conscious scheduling
03

Residential painting

Whether your home needs a small update or a full color change, our family-owned team delivers dependable service and thoughtful workmanship from the first conversation through the final walkthrough.

  • Occupied homes and renovations
  • Interior and exterior projects
  • Clean, considerate job sites
04

Commercial painting

Give customers, employees and tenants a polished environment. We provide professional painting for offices, retail spaces and other commercial properties while working to minimize disruption.

  • Offices and retail environments
  • Interior and exterior surfaces
  • Reliable project communication
05

Cabinet painting & refinishing

Update kitchens, bathrooms and built-ins without replacing the cabinetry. A carefully applied painted or stained finish can give cabinets a clean, renewed appearance.

  • Kitchen and bathroom cabinets
  • Painted and stained finishes
  • Detailed surface preparation
06

Deck & fence staining

Help wood surfaces stand up to sun and moisture while bringing out their natural character. We stain decks and fences for a more finished look and added protection.

  • Decks, fences and outdoor wood
  • Cleaning and preparation
  • Protective stain application

New construction painting

We work with homeowners, builders and property professionals to create clean, consistent finishes in newly built spaces, with attention to scheduling and project details.

  • Residential new builds
  • Commercial construction
  • Walls, ceilings, trim and more

Limewash finishes

Add soft movement and natural variation to masonry and other suitable surfaces. Limewash creates a distinctive, breathable finish with old-world character.

  • Distinctive mineral appearance
  • Natural color variation
  • Interior and exterior applications

Frequently asked questions

Planning your painting project.

Have a different question? Call our family team and we will be glad to help.

What painting services do you provide?

We provide interior and exterior painting, residential and commercial painting, cabinet painting and refinishing, deck and fence staining, new construction painting and limewash finishes.

What areas do you serve?

We serve Lafayette, West Lafayette, communities throughout Tippecanoe County and surrounding areas in Indiana. Call us to confirm availability for your address.

Do you paint both homes and businesses?

Yes. Our team handles residential and commercial projects, from individual rooms and full home interiors to offices, retail spaces and building exteriors.

How do I request an estimate?

Call A&C Painting RS at 765-532-0262. We will learn about your project and discuss the next step.
